claims.text: 美联储在2025年12月10日的FOMC声明中将联邦基金利率目标区间下调1/4个百分点，至3.5%至3.75%。

citations.quotation: the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent

limitations: 来源声明为部分节选（source_coverage: partial），未包含完整FOMC声明；下调前的前一目标区间未在提供的文本中明确给出，系根据下调幅度推断。
发布日期为声明标注日期（2025-12-10），未独立核实。

facts.label: 联邦基金利率目标区间

citation.quotation: lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent
lower the interest rate paid on reserve balances to 3.65 percent, effective December 11, 2025
